about: Bowl Lane (xs_bowl_lane: tools/bake/bowl_lane -> Workspace.Expansion.F2) review views. Make: lune run tools/bake/main.luau; lune run tools/bake/editor_ground.luau; lune run tools/bake/attractions.luau; lune run tools/bake/backdrop.luau; lune run tools/bake/lounge_classic.luau; lune run tools/bake/bowl_lane.luau; lune run tools/review/export.luau (it takes in every build/Expansion_F*.rbxm); lune run tools/review/lounge_classic.luau --out build/review/bowl_scene.json; then /root/.cache/spicy-rodents/venv/bin/python -I tools/review/render.py --scene build/review/bowl_scene.json --views docs/renders/bowl_lane/views.json --out build/review/bowl_lane --threads 2. Eye-level views are a person's eye over the ground (aboveGround). The offline renderer draws the town's trees as nothing (they are uploaded meshes) and does not light the lamps by day.

views.name: bl_01_from_junction
views.desc: At the junction with the cross street (the name sign on the left), down the lane east: the sidewalks, kerbs, lamps, the steakhouse's empty site on the right.

views.name: bl_02_alley_walk
views.desc: Down the Alley Walk from Main Street's side, over the crossing, to the bowling alley's doors and ramp.

views.name: bl_03_alley_front
views.desc: From the north sidewalk opposite, the alley's front on the lane: the steps walk, the ramp, the pylon.

views.name: bl_04_lounge
views.desc: The south sidewalk in front of THE GILDED ACORN: its forecourt meets the paving at D -32.

views.name: bl_05_turning_bay
views.desc: East to the turning bay at the end of the lane, its kerb on three sides.

views.name: bl_06_air
views.desc: From 140 st up north of the lane: the whole of Bowl Lane from the cross street to the turning bay, the Alley Walk from Main Street.
